UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and preferences within the ExpenseWise application, linked to an external authentication system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to the user's ID from an external authentication system.

username.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's profile picture or avatar.

preferredCurrency.description: The currency preferred by the user for tracking expenses (e.g., 'INR', 'USD', 'EUR').

darkModeEnabled.description: Indicates if the user has enabled the dark mode interface preference.

budgetLimit.description: The optional monthly budget limit set by the user for spending tracking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a classification for expenses (e.g., Food, Travel, Shopping).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The descriptive name of the expense category (e.g., 'Food', 'Bills').

description.description: A brief explanation or context for the category.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this category belongs to, allowing for user-defined categories. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Category)

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: Represents a method used for making an expense (e.g., Cash, Credit Card, Debit Card).

id.description: Unique identifier for the PaymentMethod entity.

name.description: The descriptive name of the payment method (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Cash').

description.description: A brief explanation or details for the payment method.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this payment method belongs to, allowing for user-defined payment methods. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PaymentMethod)

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a single recorded financial expenditure by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

title.description: A short, descriptive name or summary for the expense.

amount.description: The monetary value of the expense.

expenseDate.description: The specific date when the expense occurred.

categoryId.description: Reference to the Category for this expense. (Relationship: Category 1:N Expense)

paymentMethodId.description: Reference to the PaymentMethod used for this expense. (Relationship: PaymentMethod 1:N Expense)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who recorded this expense. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Expense)

notes.description: Optional additional details or comments about the expense.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the expense record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the expense record was last updated.

AIInteraction.title: AIInteraction
AIInteraction.description: Represents a user's question and the AI's response for financial advice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIInteraction entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who asked the question.

question.description: The question asked by the user.

answer.description: The response generated by the AI.

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions provided by the AI.

sentiment.description: The tone of the AI's response.

definition.description: Stores the profile information and preferences for a specific user.
Stores individual expense records for a user.
Stores the history of user questions and AI responses.

firestore.reasoning: Standard user-owned data structure with denormalized userId for secure querying.
